title: depends_on does not wait for ready

blocks.content: By default depends_on only orders container starts. A database process accepting connections takes longer than its container taking off, so the API can still come up first and fail.

blocks.title: Pair it with a healthcheck
blocks.content: Add condition: service_healthy and give the dependency a healthcheck. Then Compose waits for ready rather than merely started.

items: Your app should retry its first connection regardless
A container that exits on a transient failure will be restarted anyway
Never rely on a fixed sleep to order startup
